newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore Telecom and Burma in data link.
newsitem.headline: Singapore Telecom and Burma in data link.

text.p: Singapore Telecom (SingTel) said on Tuesday Burma has set up its first data communications link with the world and has chosen Singapore as its gateway.
Last month, SingTel and Myanmar PTT established a 64 kpbs link between the two countries.
The link using Telepac, SingTel's packet switched services, enables Burma to reach out to 110 destinations in more than 90 countries, said the SingTel statement.
The statement also said SingTel was in the process of negotiating with the relevant authorities in Cambodia and Loas to establish similar data links.
